import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from robot import tools, handoff, target, query
from ora_lib import current, Point, Direction
import scene

ARM = 'left'
PAD = 0.1501                 # nominal pad centre along approach from link6
CLEAR_PAD_M = 0.002          # pad centre above shaft centre
TOL_M = 0.010                # arrival tolerance
PRE_UP_M = 0.07              # pregrasp height above grasp
LIFT_M = 0.08

obs = current()
m = scene.mallet(obs)
if 'error' in m:
    handoff('mallet not measured', **{k: v for k, v in m.items()})
ball = np.asarray(m['ball_center'], float); rball = float(m['ball_r'])
axis = np.asarray(m['shaft_axis'], float); far = np.asarray(m['shaft_far_end'], float)
zc = float(m['shaft_center_z'])
print("MALLET ball", np.round(ball, 4).tolist(), "r", round(rball, 4),
      "axis", np.round(axis, 3).tolist(), "far", np.round(far, 4).tolist(),
      "center_z", round(zc, 4), "diam", round(m['shaft_diam'], 4))
if not (0.008 < rball < 0.020 and 0.008 < m['shaft_diam'] < 0.030 and abs(zc - 0.774) < 0.008):
    handoff('mallet geometry out of range', ball=ball.tolist(), r=rball,
            diam=m['shaft_diam'], center_z=zc)

grasp_p = far + (ball - far) * 0.36
grasp_p = np.array([grasp_p[0], grasp_p[1], zc])
down = np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
jaw_g = np.cross(down, axis); jaw_g /= np.linalg.norm(jaw_g)

def orient(a, j):
    a = np.asarray(a, float); a /= np.linalg.norm(a)
    j = np.asarray(j, float); j = j - a * (j @ a); j /= np.linalg.norm(j)
    return np.stack([a, j, np.cross(a, j)], axis=1)

R_g = orient(down, jaw_g)
flange_g = grasp_p - down * (PAD + CLEAR_PAD_M)
flange_pre = flange_g + np.array([0.0, 0.0, PRE_UP_M])
q_g = Rot.from_matrix(R_g).as_quat()
print("grasp_p", np.round(grasp_p, 4).tolist(), "flange_g", np.round(flange_g, 4).tolist(),
      "tips_z", round(flange_g[2] - 0.15757, 4), "flange_pre", np.round(flange_pre, 4).tolist())

rc = query("reach_check", arm=ARM, poses=[[*flange_pre.tolist(), *q_g.tolist()],
                                          [*flange_g.tolist(), *q_g.tolist()]])
ok = [r.get('reachable') for r in rc.get('results', [])]
print("reach pregrasp/grasp", ok)
if not all(ok):
    handoff('grasp pose not reachable', reach=rc.get('results'))

ap = Direction(down, 'world'); jw = Direction(jaw_g, 'world')

# ---- 1. pregrasp ----
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(flange_pre, 'world'), approach=ap, jaw_line=jw,
                                        interaction='free_space')})
print("pregrasp:", r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff('pregrasp move failed', status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
obs = current(); p_now = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).position.xyz, float)
miss = float(np.linalg.norm(p_now - flange_pre))
print("pregrasp measured", np.round(p_now, 4).tolist(), "miss", round(miss, 4))
if miss > TOL_M:
    handoff('pregrasp missed', miss=miss, now=p_now.tolist(), want=flange_pre.tolist())

# ---- 2. dry run then descend ----
tgt_g = target(Point(flange_g, 'world'), approach=ap, jaw_line=jw, interaction='precision')
dr = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt_g}, dry_run=True)
print("dry_run descent feasible:", dr.feasible, dr.summary[:300] if dr.summary else '')
if not dr.feasible:
    handoff('descent infeasible', failure=dr.failure_code, summary=dr.summary)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt_g}, speed='careful', slow_approaching=True)
print("descent:", r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff('descent failed', status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
obs = current()
p_g = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).position.xyz, float); q_now = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyzw, float)
miss = float(np.linalg.norm(p_g - flange_g))
print("grasp measured", np.round(p_g, 4).tolist(), "miss", round(miss, 4), "q", np.round(q_now, 4).tolist())
if miss > TOL_M:
    handoff('grasp pose missed', miss=miss, now=p_g.tolist(), want=flange_g.tolist())

# ball offset in the tcp frame at the grasp pose (ball still resting on the table)
R_meas = Rot.from_quat(q_now).as_matrix()
b_local = R_meas.T @ (ball - p_g)
print("b_local", np.round(b_local, 4).tolist())
if abs(b_local[1]) > 0.02 or abs(b_local[0] - (PAD + CLEAR_PAD_M)) > 0.02 or not (0.05 < abs(b_local[2]) < 0.16):
    handoff('ball offset unexpected', b_local=b_local.tolist())

# ---- 3. close jaws ----
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: 'close'})
print("close:", r.status, r.failure_code, "opening", r.measured_opening, r.measured_aperture_mm)
obs = current()
op = obs.end_effectors[ARM]['gripper'].get('measured_opening_normalized')
print("measured opening norm", op)

# ---- 4. lift ----
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(flange_pre, 'world'), approach=ap, jaw_line=jw,
                                        interaction='precision')}, speed='normal')
print("lift:", r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff('lift failed', status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
obs = current()
p_now = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).position.xyz, float); q_now2 = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyzw, float)
exp_ball = p_now + Rot.from_quat(q_now2).as_matrix() @ b_local
found = scene.find_ball_near(obs, exp_ball, radius=0.035)
print("after lift: tcp", np.round(p_now, 4).tolist(), "expected ball", np.round(exp_ball, 4).tolist(),
      "ball found", found.get('n'), "mean", None if 'mean' not in found else np.round(found['mean'], 4).tolist())
lifted = ('mean' in found) and found['n'] >= 25 and \
         float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(found['mean']) - exp_ball)) < 0.025
print("GRASP_OK", lifted)
np.save('/work/b_local.npy', b_local)
if not lifted:
    handoff('mallet not lifted with the gripper', found=found.get('n'),
            expected=exp_ball.tolist(), mean=None if 'mean' not in found else np.asarray(found['mean']).tolist())
print("RESULT_OK ball", np.round(found['mean'], 4).tolist())

def find_ball_near(obs, p_exp, radius=0.03, cam_name='head'):
    """Red ball pixels of the head view within `radius` of a world point."""
    from ora_lib import Point, project
    cam = obs.camera(cam_name)
    K = np.asarray(cam.K, float); M = np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world, float)
    px = project(Point(np.asarray(p_exp, float), 'world'), cam_name)
    u0, v0 = px.uv
    if not np.isfinite(u0) or not np.isfinite(v0):
        return dict(n=0, uv=None, reason='projection')
    R = 16
    x0 = max(0, int(round(u0)) - R); x1 = min(cam.rgb.shape[1]-1, int(round(u0)) + R)
    y0 = max(0, int(round(v0)) - R); y1 = min(cam.rgb.shape[0]-1, int(round(v0)) + R)
    sd = cam.depth_m[y0:y1+1, x0:x1+1]; srgb = cam.rgb[y0:y1+1, x0:x1+1].astype(float)/255.0
    vs, us = np.nonzero(np.isfinite(sd))
    if len(vs) == 0:
        return dict(n=0, uv=[u0, v0], reason='no_depth')
    uv = np.stack([us + x0, vs + y0], 1).astype(float)
    P = G.transform_points(G.back_project(uv, sd[vs, us], K), M)
    C = srgb[vs, us]
    red = (C[:, 0] > 0.30) & (C[:, 0] > 1.7*C[:, 1]) & (C[:, 0] > 1.7*C[:, 2])
    d = np.linalg.norm(P - np.asarray(p_exp, float), axis=1)
    m = red & (d < radius)
    if m.sum() == 0:
        return dict(n=0, uv=[float(u0), float(v0)], red_n=int(red.sum()))
    Q = P[m]
    return dict(n=int(m.sum()), uv=[float(u0), float(v0)], mean=Q.mean(0),
                spread=float(np.percentile(np.linalg.norm(Q - Q.mean(0), axis=1), 90)),
                red_n=int(red.sum()))

from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current, Point
import scene

CLEAR_PAD_M = 0.002

    handoff('mallet not measured', **m)

zc = float(m['shaft_center_z'])

if not (0.008 < rball < 0.020 and 0.008 < m['shaft_diam'] < 0.030 and abs(zc - 0.774) < 0.010):
    handoff('mallet geometry out of range', ball=ball.tolist(), r=rball, diam=m['shaft_diam'], center_z=zc)

grasp_p = far + (ball - far) * 0.36
grasp_p = np.array([grasp_p[0], grasp_p[1], zc])
down = np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
jaw_g = np.cross(down, axis); jaw_g /= np.linalg.norm(jaw_g)

      "flange_pre", np.round(flange_pre, 4).tolist())

print("tcp now", np.round(p_now, 4).tolist(), "dist to pre", round(float(np.linalg.norm(p_now - flange_pre)), 4))
if float(np.linalg.norm(p_now - flange_pre)) > 0.005:
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(flange_pre, 'world'), interaction='free_space')})
    print("to pregrasp:", r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
    if not r.ok:
        handoff('pregrasp move failed', status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
    obs = current(); p_now = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).position.xyz, float)
    if float(np.linalg.norm(p_now - flange_pre)) > TOL_M:
        handoff('pregrasp missed', now=p_now.tolist(), want=flange_pre.tolist())

# ---- descend holding current orientation ----
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(flange_g, 'world'), interaction='precision')},
                    speed='normal', slow_approaching=True)
print("descent:", r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:

R_g = Rot.from_quat(q_g).as_matrix()
b_local = R_g.T @ (ball - p_g)
print("b_local", np.round(b_local, 4).tolist(), "approach_world", np.round(R_g[:,0],3).tolist(),
      "jaw_world", np.round(R_g[:,1],3).tolist())
if abs(b_local[1]) > 0.02 or abs(b_local[0] - (PAD + CLEAR_PAD_M)) > 0.02 or not (0.05 < abs(b_local[2]) < 0.16):
    handoff('ball offset unexpected', b_local=b_local.tolist())

r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: 'close'})
print("close:", r.status, r.failure_code, "opening", r.measured_opening, "aperture_mm", r.measured_aperture_mm)
obs = current()
print("encoder opening now", obs.end_effectors[ARM]['gripper'].get('measured_opening_normalized'))

r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(flange_pre, 'world'), interaction='precision')}, speed='normal')
print("lift:", r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff('lift failed', status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
obs = current()
p_now = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).position.xyz, float); q_now = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyzw, float)
exp_ball = p_now + Rot.from_quat(q_now).as_matrix() @ b_local

print("ball found n=", found.get('n'), "mean", None if 'mean' not in found else np.round(found['mean'], 4).tolist(),

lifted = ('mean' in found) and found['n'] >= 25 and float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(found['mean']) - exp_ball)) < 0.025
print("GRASP_OK", lifted)

    json.dump(dict(b_local=b_local.tolist(), flange_pre=flange_pre.tolist(),
                   flange_g=flange_g.tolist(), grasp_p=grasp_p.tolist(),
                   ball=ball.tolist(), ball_r=rball, shaft_axis=axis.tolist(),
                   shaft_far=far.tolist(), measured_ball=found['mean'].tolist(),
                   tcp=p_now.tolist(), q=q_now.tolist()), open('/work/grasp_state.json','w'), indent=1)
if not lifted:
    handoff('mallet not lifted with the gripper', n=found.get('n'),
            expected=exp_ball.tolist(), mean=None if 'mean' not in found else np.asarray(found['mean']).tolist())
print("OK")

import sys, json
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from robot import tools, handoff, target, query
from ora_lib import current, Point, Direction
import scene

ARM = 'left'
TOL = 0.012
ABOVE_M = 0.06
CLEAR_M = 0.0015
R_BALL = 0.0127
DOWN = np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
JAW_STRIKE = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0])      # with approach -Z this points the mallet +X
MALLET_DIR = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
k0, k1 = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2])

g = json.load(open('/work/grasp_state.json'))
b_local = np.asarray(g['b_local'], float)

obs = current()
kt = scene.key_table(obs)
if isinstance(kt, dict):
    handoff('key table failed', **kt)
json.dump(kt, open('/work/keys.json', 'w'), indent=1)
print("KEYS", [(k['i'], round(k['xc'], 4), round(k['yc'], 4), round(k['z_top'], 4)) for k in kt])

def state(obs):
    p = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).position.xyz, float)
    q = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyzw, float)
    return p, q, Rot.from_quat(q).as_matrix()

def check_hold(obs, label):
    p, q, R = state(obs)
    exp = p + R @ b_local
    f = scene.find_ball_near(obs, exp, radius=0.030)
    print(label, "tcp", np.round(p, 4).tolist(), "blade-expected", np.round(exp, 4).tolist(),
          "n=", f.get('n'), "mean", None if 'mean' not in f else np.round(f['mean'], 4).tolist())
    if f.get('n', 0) < 25 or float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(f['mean']) - exp)) > 0.025:
        handoff('mallet not held: ' + label, n=f.get('n'), exp=exp.tolist())
    return p, R

p_now, q_now, R_now = state(obs)
print("tcp", np.round(p_now, 4).tolist(), "approach", np.round(R_now[:, 0], 3).tolist(),
      "jaw", np.round(R_now[:, 1], 3).tolist(), "mall dir", np.round(R_now[:, 2], 3).tolist())
check_hold(obs, 'start')

# ---- turn the mallet to point +X ----
if R_now[:, 2] @ MALLET_DIR < 0.995:
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(p_now, 'world'),
                                             approach=Direction(DOWN, 'world'),
                                             jaw_line=Direction(JAW_STRIKE, 'world'),
                                             interaction='precision')}, speed='normal')
    print("rotate wrist:", r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
    if not r.ok:
        handoff('wrist rotation failed', status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
    obs = current()
    p_now, q_now, R_now = state(obs)
    print("after rotate: tcp", np.round(p_now, 4).tolist(), "mall dir", np.round(R_now[:, 2], 3).tolist())
    if R_now[:, 2] @ MALLET_DIR < 0.99 or float(np.linalg.norm(p_now - np.array(json.load(open('/work/grasp_state.json'))['flange_pre']))) > 0.02:
        handoff('wrist rotation not as asked', mallet_dir=R_now[:, 2].tolist(), tcp=p_now.tolist())
    check_hold(obs, 'after rotate')

off = R_now @ b_local
print("mallet offset world", np.round(off, 4).tolist())
if off[0] < 0.09 or abs(off[2] + 0.149) > 0.02:
    handoff('mallet not pointing +X', off=off.tolist())

ball_t, flange_t, above_t = {}, {}, {}
for k in kt:
    ball_t[k['i']] = np.array([k['xc'], k['yc'], k['z_top'] + R_BALL + CLEAR_M])
    flange_t[k['i']] = ball_t[k['i']] - off
    above_t[k['i']] = flange_t[k['i']] + np.array([0.0, 0.0, ABOVE_M])
for i in range(8):
    print("PLAN k%d ball %s flange %s" % (i, np.round(ball_t[i], 4).tolist(), np.round(flange_t[i], 4).tolist()))

poses = []
for i in range(8):
    poses.append([*above_t[i].tolist(), *q_now.tolist()])
    poses.append([*flange_t[i].tolist(), *q_now.tolist()])
rc = query("reach_check", arm=ARM, poses=poses)
ok = [r.get('reachable') for r in rc.get('results', [])]
print("reach above/strike:", ok, "margins", [round(r.get('joint_limit_margin_deg') or 0, 1) for r in rc.get('results', [])])
if not all(ok):
    handoff('strike pose unreachable', bad=[i for i, o in enumerate(ok) if not o],
            results=[rc['results'][i] for i, o in enumerate(ok) if not o])

def do_move(p, interaction, label, speed='normal', slow=False):
    kw = dict(targets={ARM: target(Point(np.asarray(p, float), 'world'), interaction=interaction)},
              speed=speed)
    if slow:
        kw['slow_approaching'] = True
    r = tools.move_pose(**kw)
    print(label, r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m, "contact", r.contact)
    if not r.ok:
        handoff('move failed: ' + label, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
    o = current()
    pn = np.asarray(o.pose(ARM).position.xyz, float)
    miss = float(np.linalg.norm(pn - np.asarray(p, float)))
    print("   measured", np.round(pn, 4).tolist(), "miss", round(miss, 4))
    if miss > TOL:
        handoff('move missed: ' + label, miss=miss, now=pn.tolist(), want=np.asarray(p).tolist())
    return o

obs = do_move(above_t[k0], 'free_space', 'travel->above%d' % k0)
check_hold(obs, 'above%d' % k0)
for i in range(k0, k1 + 1):
    if i > k0:
        obs = do_move(above_t[i], 'free_space', 'travel->above%d' % i)
        check_hold(obs, 'above%d' % i)
    obs = do_move(flange_t[i], 'precision', 'strike%d' % i, slow=True)
    pn, Rn = state(obs)[0], state(obs)[2]
    ballw = pn + Rn @ b_local
    print("STRIKE k%d ball world %s want %s lowest-vs-top %s" % (
        i, np.round(ballw, 4).tolist(), np.round(ball_t[i], 4).tolist(),
        round(float(ballw[2] - R_BALL - kt[i]['z_top']), 4)))
    obs = do_move(above_t[i], 'precision', 'lift%d' % i)
    check_hold(obs, 'lift%d' % i)
print("DONE", k0, k1)
